Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

Any mount touching, pinching, or obscuring the sheet:  [ ] no  [ ] yes

___________________________________________________________________________________

Curling, cockling, buckling, planar distortion, or edge lift:  [ ] none  [ ] present
Location/severity: ________________________________________________________________

Description/location: _____________________________________________________________

[ ] no  [ ] yes  [ ] unknown
Details: __________________________________________________________________________

E. ABRASION AND SURFACE CONDITION
Visible abrasion, scuffing, rubbing, scratches, pigment disturbance, or surface loss:
[ ] none  [ ] present  [ ] uncertain
Location/severity: ________________________________________________________________
Any evidence that the sheet is rubbing against glazing, mat, backing, or a mount?
[ ] no  [ ] yes  [ ] uncertain
Details: __________________________________________________________________________

F. ADHESIVE CONTACT
Any visible adhesive, tape, residue, staining, or attachment touching the watercolor sheet?
[ ] no  [ ] yes  [ ] uncertain
Any pressure-sensitive adhesive used or newly introduced in the enclosure?
[ ] no  [ ] yes  [ ] unknown
Details/action taken: ______________________________________________________________

G. MAT, WINDOW, AND ENCLOSURE
Archival mat appears clean and stable:  [ ] yes  [ ] no  [ ] uncertain
Window remains 6.75 × 8.75 inches and unobstructed:  [ ] yes  [ ] no  [ ] uncertain
Mat movement, bowing, discoloration, pests, or particulate debris:  [ ] none  [ ] present
Description: ______________________________________________________________________

H. CONSERVATION FOLLOW-UP
Immediate handling or display change required:  [ ] no  [ ] yes
Keep displayed as-is:  [ ] yes  [ ] no
Remove from display and isolate pending advice:  [ ] no  [ ] yes
Consult a paper conservator:  [ ] no  [ ] yes  [ ] consider if change persists
Repair or follow-up needed:  [ ] none observed  [ ] monitor  [ ] home mount review  [ ] professional assessment
Reason and recommended next step: __________________________________________________
___________________________________________________________________________________

OBSERVATIONS
Overall condition at this inspection:
[ ] no visible change from the 2026-01-04 baseline
[ ] minor change — monitor
[ ] significant change — restrict handling/display and seek advice

Free observations:
___________________________________________________________________________________
___________________________________________________________________________________
___________________________________________________________________________________
___________________________________________________________________________________

INSPECTION SIGN-OFF
Inspector signature/initials: ______________________________   Date: ______________
Next annual inspection target: 2029-01-01
